name: The Rebel Enforcers

tenures.source: the promotion's own 'Schools Out For Summer' pay-per-view broadcast of 26 July 1998 and the promotion's own 'Scorch Wave 98' pay-per-view broadcast of 30 August 1998

caption: A country-styled tag team, managed by Uncle Jessie, who lost a hard-core #1 contenders match to Death and Destruction.

name: Death and Destruction

tenures.source: the promotion's own 'Schools Out For Summer' pay-per-view broadcast of 26 July 1998 and the promotion's own 'Scorch Wave 98' pay-per-view broadcast of 30 August 1998
tenures.note: Billed by the promotion's own broadcasts as “DAD,” earlier led by the promotion's own president under his ring name before Smoke took it over.

caption: Smoke and Who Else's tag team, which won a hard-core #1 contenders match over the Rebel Enforcers and then a loser-leaves-CROW match over the Dark Riders.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (death-and-destruction-rwa-rugged); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.
Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (death-and-destruction-wewf); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.

name: The Gospel Preachers

tenures.source: the promotion's own 'Scorch Wave 98' pay-per-view broadcast of 30 August 1998
tenures.note: Held the CROW Tag Team Championship since May 1998 by the broadcast's own commentary, until losing it to Element Of Pain.

caption: A tag team of preachers who held the CROW Tag Team Championship since May 1998 until losing it to Element Of Pain at Scorch Wave 98.

name: Element Of Pain

tenures.source: the promotion's own 'Scorch Wave 98' pay-per-view broadcast of 30 August 1998
tenures.note: Part of the D-Brigade stable led by the Destroyer, whose interference helped them win the CROW Tag Team Championship.

caption: Part of the Destroyer's D-Brigade stable; won the CROW Tag Team Championship from the Gospel Preachers at Scorch Wave 98 with the champion's interference.

name: The Dark Riders

tenures.source: the promotion's own 'Scorch Wave 98' pay-per-view broadcast of 30 August 1998

caption: A tag team billed from “Hell” who lost a loser-leaves-CROW match to Death and Destruction, ending their run with the promotion.
